knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The right step is a comparison with real costs and with Australian conditions. Accepting or refusing without comparing is not sound.
Under a facility contract the trainer pays for the space and carries their own costs. The facility's running costs are not the trainer's.
US figures and rules are recorded as US and historical. They are not Australian facts unless checked.

practicalCriteria: Model comparison: the learner scores all three models on the same six criteria, with a note for each score. The assessor checks that the same criteria were applied to each model.
Cost list: the learner lists the cost per session for the chosen model, including travel time where relevant. The assessor checks the list against the learner's own figures.
Source marking: the learner marks each US or Australian legal point in the notes as US, historical or not applicable. The assessor confirms no US figure is used as an Australian fact.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed practical record saved and dated
Assessor sign-off on the practical criteria
stopWorkCriteria: A space or facility arrangement is about to start without a written agreement on fees, hours and terms
A US figure from the source is about to be used as an Australian rate, benchmark or legal rule
A client session is about to take place at a facility where the trainer has not agreed how the space is paid for
